Write a List of Analysis Workbook

Source: R/write_loa.R
ak_write_loa.Rd

Writes the sheets as a styled List of Analysis workbook: a readme sheet with one section per sheet, in sheet order; a navy header; an italic row of column descriptions under the header of analysis_variables, disaggregation_variables and settings (skipped by read_loa_workbook()); a description column in settings and route_analysis; and drop-down lists for analysis_type, sample_base and include.

Usage

ak_write_loa(sheets, path, dropdown_rows = 1000L)

Arguments

sheets

A named list of data frames, named by sheet (analysis_variables, disaggregation_variables, settings, ...). Former column names (full_sample_base, full_sample_label) are written under their current names. Empty optional sheets are left out.

path

Where to write the .xlsx.

dropdown_rows

Number of data rows the drop-down lists cover.

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

A drop-down list is one rule over a range of cells, so its size in the file does not depend on how many rows it covers.

Examples

sheets <- list(
  analysis_variables = data.frame(
    analysis_type = "prop_select_one",
    analysis_var = "Q27",
    section = "Demographics"
  ),
  settings = data.frame(setting = "sm_separator", value = "/")
)
ak_write_loa(sheets, tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx"))
